import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (3, 15))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 15)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(15)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: switch to 3D and wait for layout
toggle to orthographic via setView
steps.report: { ortho: a.view.orthographic3D, rendererOrtho: a.renderer ? a.renderer.isOrtho3D : null }

steps.name: projection changes what is drawn: equal lengths near and far differ in perspective, match in orthographic
steps.eval: window.__rPersp = (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors; let zmin = 1e9, zmax = -1e9, imin = 0, imax = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const z = xy[3*i+2]; if (z < zmin) { zmin = z; imin = i; } if (z > zmax) { zmax = z; imax = i; } } const len = (i) => { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[3*i], xy[3*i+1], xy[3*i+2]), q = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[3*i] + 1, xy[3*i+1], xy[3*i+2]); return Math.hypot(q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]); }; return len(imin) / len(imax); })(); a.setView({ orthographic3D: true }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__rOrtho = (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors; let zmin = 1e9, zmax = -1e9, imin = 0, imax = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const z = xy[3*i+2]; if (z < zmin) { zmin = z; imin = i; } if (z > zmax) { zmax = z; imax = i; } } const len = (i) => { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[3*i], xy[3*i+1], xy[3*i+2]), q = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[3*i] + 1, xy[3*i+1], xy[3*i+2]); return Math.hypot(q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]); }; return len(imin) / len(imax); })(); a.setView({ orthographic3D: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

steps.name: depth fade is off by default
depth fade changes the drawn pixels (far points dimmer)
steps.eval: a.setView({ depthFade: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let s = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) s += d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2]; window.__bOff = s; a.setView({ depthFade: true }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); { const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let s = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) s += d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2]; window.__bOn = s; }
